titulo_ja: こうしき の ことば (1)

おこなわれました.es: se celebró; se llevó a cabo
おこなわれました.en: was held; it was carried out

texto: It indicates that an action or situation covers a period or extension: substantive + **にわたって**. It does not necessarily mean that it will happen without interruption: **さんねん にわたって けんきゅう しました** (I investigated over three years).
It formally places an act, event or subject: substantive + **において**. It is more typical of reports and announcements than of conversation: **かいぎ は 東京 において おこなわれました** (the meeting was held in Tokyo).

intro: Today you learn words from formal language, reports and news. They serve to say how long something lasts and where it happens, with a more serious tone than in the conversation.
